s.en: My wife likes red shoes.
I bought a red hat for my grandson yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 손자에게 빨간 모자를 사 줬어요.

s.en: The apples will turn red in autumn.
My husband wears a blue shirt to work.
The sky was very blue this morning.
I will buy a blue bag for the market.
s.ko: 시장에 들고 갈 파란 가방을 살 거예요.

s.en: The bananas in the shop are still yellow.
My grandson wore a yellow coat yesterday.
The leaves will be yellow next month.
s.ko: 다음 달에는 잎이 노랗게 될 거예요.

s.en: My mother always wears white in summer.
s.ko: 어머니는 여름에 항상 흰 옷을 입으세요.

s.en: I bought white cups for the kitchen last week.
s.ko: 지난주에 부엌에 쓸 흰 컵들을 샀어요.

s.en: The hills will be white with snow tomorrow.
s.ko: 내일 언덕이 눈으로 하얗게 될 거예요.

s.en: Black shoes go with any coat.
s.ko: 검은 신발은 어떤 코트에나 잘 어울려요.

s.en: My son wore a black coat to the meeting yesterday.
s.ko: 어제 아들은 회의에 검은 코트를 입고 갔어요.

s.en: I will choose the black bag, not the brown one.
s.ko: 갈색 말고 검은 가방을 고를 거예요.

s.en: My old shoes are brown and soft.
The bread was brown and warm this morning.
The leaves will turn brown soon.
My daughter loves pink dresses.
The flowers were pink in the market last spring.
I will wear my pink hat to the meeting.
s.ko: 모임에 분홍 모자를 쓰고 갈 거예요.

s.en: Purple grapes are sweeter than green ones.
My wife bought a purple hat last week.
The flowers will be purple in May.
My hair is gray now, but I like it.
s.ko: 제 머리는 이제 회색이지만 저는 마음에 들어요.

s.en: The sky was gray all day yesterday.
I will buy a gray coat for my husband.
s.ko: 남편에게 회색 코트를 사 줄 거예요.

s.en: What color do you like for a bag?
The shop had every color of hat last week.
s.ko: 지난주에 그 가게에는 모든 색의 모자가 있었어요.

s.en: We will choose the color together tomorrow.
s.ko: 내일 우리는 함께 색을 고를 거예요.
